'''Esroc''' was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] operating in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. Esroc owned a battered [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], [[DD-09]], who assisted the thief in committing petty crimes.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
